messages:
Maya: Quick mid-q pulse — sharing what actually shipped vs slipped in Milestone A, and a short list of asks (CR pings + owners). TL;DR: runtime perf fix shipped, telemetry backfill slipped, need CRs for two PRs.

Josh: Shipped runtime perf tweak (v2.1) to dedicated pools. Metrics look stable in canary. :tada:

Priya: Confirmed, saw 25% lower p95 on canary. I flipped the feature flag for 50% traffic. No regressions so far.

Lia: Telemetry backfill did not land — blocked on schema change approval and infra rollout. ETA now +2w.

Kai: Infra note: staging network policy change from vendor stalled; they asked for additional certs. Sam opened ticket with vendor yesterday.

Maya: Owners please callouts: Lia — you own the telemetry backfill timeline; Kai — vendor ticket owner. Josh/Priya — we need CRs merged for the routing and batching PRs so we can ramp to 100%.

Priya: Routing PR is ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4785
PR description: small routing fallback + unit tests. Needs 1 approval from eng-platform.

Josh: Batching PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4822
Contains batching config changes and perf knobs. I need a quick security review (config parsing) — @Kai?

Kai: I can do the sec review tonight. If nothing major, I can approve tomorrow morning. Also asking infra to attach the required cert chain to the staging node by EOD.

Maya: Great. Can folks do quick reviews today so we can roll tomorrow? Owner checklist: 
- Lia: unblock schema approval (who to ping?)
- Kai: finish vendor cert + sec review of batching PR
- Eng-platform: review routing PR (Priya)
- Josh: prepare canary ramp plan (what % per hour)

Priya: For schema approver, ping @tableau (data infra) — Lia, I can DM them the change set.

Lia: Please do, Priya. Also I'll split the backfill into two smaller jobs to reduce blast radius once schema is approved.

Josh: Canary ramp plan: 50% -> 75% -> 100% over 2h windows (monitor token latency / error-rate). I’ll post the runbook in the release thread.

Maya: Awesome. Quick CR ping status updates here when you approve. If any of these slip further, call it out.

build-bot: Deploy job #20011 finished: runtime-v2.1 canary deployed to pool-a (sha: ab12c3). Logs: http://ci.redwood/deploys/20011

Priya: I left a comment on PR #4785 (minor test nit). Will tidy and request final review from eng-platform.

Kai: Reviewed #4822, left one comment about config validation. Will recheck after fix and approve.

Maya: Thanks — plan is to merge both PRs and then ramp to 100% tomorrow 11am PT if no issues. Lia, update ETA on the backfill in this thread once you have schema sign-off.

Lia: Will do. If schema approver responds today, aim for backfill start early next week.

Maya: Optional: if anyone wants to join a short async sync at 10am PT tomorrow for rollout watch, drop a :hand: here.

Josh: :hand: I’ll be around for the first hour of the ramp.

Priya: :hand: I can monitor metrics too.

Kai: I’ll be on-call for infra alerts.

Maya: Perfect. Thanks team — tiny follow-ups in PRs and vendor ticket, then we should be in good shape.
